Skip next section Manipur singer killed after confronting group drinking outside Delhi home 09/08/2026 September 8, 2026 Manipur singer killed after confronting group drinking outside Delhi home A group of men has been apprehended for beating Manipuri musician Chongtham Vikram Singh to death outside his apartment in Southeast Delhi, local media reported. The 54-year-old lived in Kilokari village, where he was allegedly assaulted by a group of delivery workers and local eatery staff after he confronted them for drinking and creating a nuisance outside his residence, police said. Seven people have been arrested, and a juvenile has been detained in relation to the assault. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi slammed local authorities and Home Minister Amit Shah, raising concerns over the safety of people from the northeastern states of India in Delhi. "A father, killed outside his own home, in his own country's capital. After many such incidents, every Northeast family in Delhi is asking the same question today - are we safe here?" he wrote on X. Chief Minister of Manipur, N Biren Singh, also offered condolences to his family, urging Delhi Police to take swift action on the matter. He also shared CCTV footage that claimed to show the accused heading downstairs after assaulting Singh. The incident has raised concerns among New Delhi's Northeast community. The area that comes under the Sunlight Colony police station is known to have a sizeable population from the region, the Telegraph newspaper reported. In 2023, a group of men assaulted a Manipuri family in the area. https://p.dw.com/p/5M7qV Skip next section Iran hails 'civilizational' relationship with India ahead of BRICS summit 09/08/2026 September 8, 2026 Iran hails 'civilizational' relationship with India ahead of BRICS summit Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan Image: Iranian Presidency Office/APAimages/IMAGO Iran highlighted its "long-standing, historic and civilizational relationship" with India ahead of President Masoud Pezeshkian's visit to New Delhi for the upcoming BRICS summit. Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Esmail Baghaei emphasized the importance Tehran places on its ties with New Delhi during a press conference. He highlighted President Pezeshkian's bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, to reaffirm Iran's plans to engage diplomatically with India to deepen economic collaboration. Referring to the upcoming BRICS summit, he added: "We will certainly make use of the opportunity provided by the BRICS Summit to continue our discussions and consultations with India in areas of mutual interest." The 18th BRICS summit will be held from September 12 to 13 at the Bharat Mandapam convention center in the Indian capital. https://p.dw.com/p/5M7pM Skip next section BAPS apologizes over Eiffel Tower row, denies preventing access 09/08/2026 September 8, 2026 BAPS apologizes over Eiffel Tower row, denies preventing access A Hindu religious group has apologized after the Eiffel Tower in Paris, France, was closed on Monday after staff went on strike to protest the exclusion of female workers during a visit by the organization. The Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS), however, reiterated that their tour was pre-coordinated with the tower's team, adding that no person was denied access. BAPS also offered apologies to anyone hurt or inconvenienced. "We understand the concerns raised and take them very seriously. Given the size of our delegation, the visit was organised in coordination with the Eiffel Tower team at the beginning of normal opening hours to minimise any inconvenience to other visitors," BAPS said in a statement on social media. "To our knowledge, at no point was anyone denied access to the Eiffel Tower. Nevertheless, we sincerely apologise to anyone who may have been hurt or inconvenienced by this situation," the statement added. Around 100 men from BAPS were visiting the landmark. The company that operates the Tower, SETE, said that the group had requested a visit as part of which the "interactions with women" would be limited. SETE accepted that the decision was a mistake: "These conditions should not have been accepted." On Sunday, BAPS conducted the consecration ceremony of France’s first traditional Hindu temple in Bussy-Saint-Georges, near Paris. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually addressed the inauguration gathering, adding that "India and France’s relations have reached new heights." https://telex.hu/sport/2026/09/08/magyar.text: Menü Kereső 40 éve várt siker: a nyolc között a női kosárlabda-válogatott a vb-n, az USA jön az elődöntőért Sport Lelik Réka mindvégig dinamikusan és ponterősen játszott – Fotó: Czeglédi Zsolt / MTI Ághassi Attila Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom A magyar női kosárlabda-válogatott a franciák elleni súlyos vereség után két győzelemmel (Nigéria és Dél-Korea) érkezett meg a világbajnokság tizenkét legjobb csapata közé. A nyolc közé jutásért Japán volt az ellenfél, és mivel a két legutóbbi meccset a magyarok megnyerték, a vb-selejtezőn és az olimpiai selejtezőn is jobbak voltak Juhász Dorkáék, volt okunk a bizakodásra. Japán hasonló stílusban játszik, mint a hétfőn legyőzött Korea, a feladat ugyanaz volt, a sebességüket megfékezni, a kinti dobásaikat kontrollálni, nem utolsósorban a magas embereinket megfelelően használni. Nem minden úgy alakult a meccsen, ahogy a tervezőasztal mellett megálmodta Völgyi Péter szövetségi kapitány, de a győzelem igazából nem forgott veszélyben. Parádésan kezdett ugyanis a csapat, 7-0-ra meglépett másfél perc alatt, Studer Ágnes triplája mellett Lelik Réka és Aho Nina duplája volt pontos. A negyed végére nemcsak sikerült megtartani ezt a különbséget, hanem a 20-12-es zárás azt jelentette, hogy még egyet sikerült is közé rakni. Lelik megtartotta az eredményességét ebben a periódusban. A 2021-ben olimpiai ezüstérmes Japán szívósan tapadt a folytatásban, ki is egyenlítettek (34-34), az utolsó másodpercekben pedig Studer megmutatta, hogy nemcsak az elején, hanem most is képes tökéletes hármasra, így gondoskodott a 37-34-es félidei vezetésről. Ritka fontos kosár volt, mert mégiscsak előnnyel lehetett a szünetre menni. Juhász Dorka most nem volt átlag feletti, Leliknek viszont sült a keze, és fontos szerepet vállalt abban, hogy a harmadik negyedben tíz pontnál is nagyobb legyen a különbség. Turner Yvonne büntetőivel 58-45-re módosította az állást a harmadik negyed végére. A zárónegyedben Dúl Panka triplájával már 14 pont is volt a különbség, és akkor már érezni lehetett, hogy ezt a meccset nem lehet elveszíteni. Kányási Veronika és a csapatkapitány Takács-Kiss Virág is dobott egy hármast fontos helyzetben, amivel 17 pontra nőtt az előny. Az utolsó három percre 76-61-re fordultunk, mert Kányási a sarokból is behintett egy hármast, ez volt a 13. tripla, és abban a mutatóban is megvertük Japánt, amiben a legerősebbnek számított szinte az egész mezőnyben. Az utolsó támadásokat már hátradőlve lehetett nézni, mert csak az volt a kérdés, mekkora különbség alakul ki a két nemzet között. A végeredmény 84-63 lett, az utolsó magyar pontokat a meccs legjobbja, a Diósgyőrből távozó Lelik Réka szerezte. Magyarország három a világranglistán magasabban rangsorolt ellenfelet győzött le (Nigéria, Korea és Japán), így jutott el oda, hogy a nyolc között csütörtökön megmérkőzhet az olimpiai és világbajnoki címvédő, és a legnagyobb favoritnak tartott Egyesült Államokkal. https://www.mynbc5.com/article/multiple-.text: A Polish man with far-right views drove into a busy central square in Krakow on Saturday and opened fire, killing six people and injuring 15 others before police shot and wounded him, authorities said. The attack, which Poland’s defense minister described as an “act of terror,” happened in Main Square, which is in the heart of Krakow’s Old Town and is a major tourist hub in the country’s second-largest city. The 25-year-old attacker drove to multiple spots in the square and opened fire at each stop with an automatic weapon, authorities said. Although they didn’t release his name, Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said the man holds “very radical” and “ultranationalistic” views. "Everything indicates that he was fascinated by far-right ideologies,” Kierwiński said at a news conference. Hours after the attack, Prime Minister Donald Tusk said authorities found the bodies of three of the suspect's close family members — two women and a man — inside of his home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, a city about 150 kilometers (93 miles) northeast of Krakow. “We have the next acts of this tragedy,” Tusk told reporters. Four women and two men were killed in the Krakow attack. At least three of the women were Polish, and one of the dead was a U.K. citizen, authorities said at a news conference. Police were still trying to identify the other two people who were killed. Authorities said a total of 13 people were hospitalized in serious condition, though that figure may include the gunman, who underwent surgery after the attack. It’s unclear how many of the injured were shot. Two of them were treated and released within hours of the mass shooting. Two police officers were among the injured, including one whose injuries were serious, Kierwiński said. Also injured in the attack were five non-Poles, police commander Marek Boroń said. People were wounded at several locations The attacker wore military-style fatigues and a bulletproof vest, and used a military-type long gun, Krakow police spokesperson Katarzyna Cisło said. Police found many other weapons and ammunition in his car. He kept firing at the police even after being shot himself, she said. The attacker engaged in a “wild ride” around Main Square, which is why people were wounded at several locations, Cisło said. Cisło added that the gunman acted alone and that the public is safe. Krakow mayor Łukasz Gibała said the city will be in official mourning until Wednesday. He vowed that Krakow will remain open to visitors despite the tragedy. “The square will belong to us again,” Gibała said in a video posted to X. Mass shootings are rare in Poland Videos posted on social media by witnesses show people running away from the square to take cover on small streets nearby, as well as first responders trying to resuscitate victims. In one video, a police officer is seen repeatedly shooting the attacker, who is lying on the street, only to later slowly collapse himself to the ground. Photos showed a Polish Medical Air Rescue helicopter after it landed in the square. It was not immediately clear whether the firearm used in Saturday’s attack, or the guns found in the perpetrator’s car, were legal. Around 411,000 people hold gun permits in Poland, which has a population of 37 million, and interest in gun ownership has been rising. Mass shootings are uncommon in Poland. However, in mid-October three attacks at schools in the central province of Mazovia took place within four days, leaving one person dead and many wounded, including children. In a post on X, Tusk praised the police officers who responded to Saturday’s tragedy. President Karol Nawrocki said his thoughts were with the victims, the wounded and their families. A tram driver reported around 3 p.m. that his vehicle was shot at by a man in a moving car while passing nearby the main square, the Krakow municipal transport company said. The window to the tram driver’s cabin was shattered. Animal rights group OTOZ Animals said the attacker also shot two horses. Both animals are alive, but one was grazed by a bullet and the other hit in the leg. White carriages drawn by horses are a main tourist attraction in the square. Warsaw mayor Rafał Trzaskowski announced increased security measures, including road barriers, along main streets in the old town in the Polish capital in the aftermath of the Krakow attack.
